==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League BroodWar Season 2''' or '''AfreecaTV StarLeague Season 2''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].<ref>[https://archive.fo/wIM1O Starleague announcement page, archived]</ref>

The Starleague was announced on November 10, 2016 with two open offline qualifiers scheduled for Seoul and Busan on November 26 and 27, 2016, respectively.

Round of 24 play will begin on December 4, 2016.<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/brood-war/516741-asl-2-ro24-brackets-flash-jaedong-bisu-stork-and-others-qualify Ro24 announcement on TL]</ref>

The final was held inside the main auditorium of Yonsei University.<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/bw-tournaments/518352-2016-asl-s2-finals-information]</ref>
During the awards ceremony it was announced the finalists would receive an additional 2500$ each, courtesy of KT Corporation.<br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7kH43ZkaeR0</embedvideo>

===Format===
<!--
;Preliminary Qualifiers
*14 groups of 32-128 players each, seven groups in each of Seoul and Busan
*Single-elimination bracket: best-of-three
*Winner of each group advances
-->
;Round of 24 group stage
*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
*Top two players in each group advance

;Round of 16 group stage
* 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[2016 AfreecaTV StarCraft League BroodWar Season 1|ASL Season 1]]
* format TBD

;Elimination Stage
*Eight player single-elimination bracket
*Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
